topic: GitHubModel.start() skips its refresh while a stopped refresh is finishing
detail: Found while fixing pollingRetriesScopesUntilTheyLoad (SP-082). stop() cancels the poll task, but a refresh it started may still be awaiting its item load; a start() in that window calls refresh(), which returns at once because isRefreshing is still set, so the reopened GitHub tab waits a full interval (30 s) before reloading, and then reloads items only. The test now waits for the refresh to end; the model is unchanged. Proposed: have start() wait for or replace the finishing refresh, or let a cancelled refresh clear isRefreshing at cancellation.
